text:
kevin: Quick heads-up: starting staged rollout 5% -> 25% for v3.4.5 now (change window 20:00-21:00 UTC). DeployBot preflight OK but flagging the release-council since there was a surprise embed quality regression in last dry-run.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary allocation created (5%). Automated percent schedule active: +5% every 5m.

tara: seeing p95 +8% on canary and an embed-quality regression signal in eval harness (cosine drop ~0.07). No 5xx. Link: https://metrics.internal/embeds/17490

sre-oncall: infra looks healthy. No mem/evict signals. This looks model-quality not infra.

kevin: OK hold the auto-increase until we review eval samples. @deploy-bot pause scheduled percent bumps.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduled percent increases paused per request.

marta: grabbing eval samples and diffing v3.4.5 vs v3.4.4 now. If it's systematic we should pin the canary back to v3.4.4-emb-safe.

release-council: Quick vote: proceed to 10% for more data, or pin to prior safe variant? We need a quorum.

tara: vote: pin. We have a measurable quality regression in embeddings in the dry-run. :thumbsup:

kevin: vote: pin as well. We can't risk wider regression.

sre-oncall: neutral but prefer limiting blast radius. No infra objections.

marta: executing pin now to v3.4.4-emb-safe for the eu-canary allocation.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.4.4-emb-safe (allocation: canary-eu-2). Audit: deploy-audit/1749012345-pin.

kevin: thanks. Please watch embed cosine, p95, and downstream freshness for 10m. If metrics recover we'll reconvene to consider a cautious bump (10%).

marta: initial diff: about 120 samples show median cosine restored to baseline after pin. I'll attach a short report to the ticket. INV-2251 created.

release-council: RN update suggestion: "Temporarily pinned eu canary to v3.4.4-emb-safe due to observed embedding quality regression in v3.4.5 canary; investigation opened (INV-2251)." Any objections?

tara: no objections. Add rollback playbook note: who unpins and verification steps.

kevin: noted. I'll update release notes and the rollback playbook with exact CLI to unpin. Also, reminder: change window ends 21:00 UTC, so keep this pinned until ML triage signs off.

sre-oncall: monitoring update in 7m: embed cosine trending back to baseline, no infra regressions.

kevin: reconvene in 10m. For now: stalled at 5% pinned. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
